title: Nvidia interim CEO Kress tells employees ‘let’s move forward’ at first all-hands meeting since Jensen Huang exit
summary: In her first all-hands meeting since taking over as interim CEO, Colette Kress addressed Nvidia employees following the departure of Jensen Huang. She emphasized the importance of moving forward collectively and expressed confidence in the company's future. Kress also announced plans for pay raises, aiming to boost morale and retain talent during this transitional period.
